d: Joyce is an accomplished 55-year-old divorcee  she welcomes five eligible men to live in her house in the Hamptons for a week, and nothing is off limits  from life-sized self-portraits to a bedroom kissing booth, romance and jealousy run wild.

Sydney is a small-town stunner and hasn't had a relationship since college  five potential partners move in for the week  an axe-throwing competition breaks out to prove they're worthy of Sydney's heart  romance runs hot through Sydney's house.

Alyssa is a sassy single mom who is a receptionist by day and go-go dancer by night  she's been single for almost five years and all she asks of her future man is that he be completely obsessed with her.

Samantha, a 53-year-old, is ready for love again after getting her heart crushed in her last relationship  the 5 men arrive at her home  a romantic walk on the beach gives way to jealousy  Sam's daughters help her confront her old bad habits.

Adriana falls hard for some of the guys after seeing how thoughtful and attentive they all are... until a scandal rocks the vibe and leaves everyone, including Adriana's friends and family, absolutely speechless.

Pole dance instructor Sienna is nothing short of a goddess, and she is ready to find her Zeus  when five guys move into her home, they battle it out on the pole  the fight for Sienna's heart is fierce, and one guy pulls a dramatic move.

Rebecca, a researcher, is quirky, hilarious and single after breaking up with the father of her ferrets  her quintet of men is quickly pushed far outside their comfort zones  with real love on the line, it's up to them to rise to the occasion.
Erica, a passionate 26-year-old, falls hard for her five guys  when Erica's friends meet the guys at the club, one guy confesses something so outrageous it shakes up the whole house.
